pages.task: See what needs my attention today (my students, new results, unassigned students I could take on) on a phone between classes
pages.summary: Works in light mode, but the counselor is sent to an 'unassigned' queue it cannot act on, the role is never explained, and the KPI tiles are unreadable in dark mode.

findings.issue: KPI tiles and the funnel table keep a white background in dark mode while their text switches to light ink, so numbers and labels nearly disappear.
findings.evidence: ts.pv2.edu.counselor_my_workspaces_5_375_dark.png; report.txt row 180 'contrast span. 1.5|th. 2.0|a. 1.2|td.ts-num 1.2'; panel.scss:117 .tsp-stat background: var(--white), :144 .tsp-table background: var(--white)
findings.fix: See pattern PT-1: replace var(--white) with var(--color-surface) (or a card token that has a dark value) in .tsp-stat, .tsp-table, .tsp-table--cards tr and .ts-table-wrap.

findings.issue: 'Needs attention' shows the counselor '۳ شرکت‌کنندگان بدون کارشناس مسئول', but the counselor has no action to take them on: the clients list offers no 'take on' / 'assign to me' action (bulk menu has only group actions) and the client page has a 500 error (P8-1). The attention item leads nowhere.
findings.evidence: counselor_my_workspaces_5_1280.txt l.36; counselor clients bulk menu l.64-65 (only افزودن/برداشتن از گروه) vs owner l.70 'تعیین کارشناس مسئول'; web_client.xml:75 form only if can_assign
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks, self-descriptiveness; ISO 9241-11 effectiveness
findings.fix: Either (a) show the item only to roles with clients:assign, and for counselors replace it with 'مراجعان باز من', or (b) give counselors a 'درخواست پذیرش این شرکت‌کننده' button on unassigned rows that creates a handover request for the owner. (b) changes the workflow.

findings.issue: The role appears only as small grey meta text ('TSW-0005 · مشاور'). Nothing tells the counselor what this role can see (own students + the unassigned queue, at counselor level) or links to /help/roles.
findings.evidence: web_shell.xml:24,44 role_label is plain text; counselor_my_workspaces_5_375.png header
findings.fix: See pattern PT-2.

findings.issue: In the funnel, zero rows still show a 2-px sliver bar, and bars start at the left (end side) edge of an RTL table.
findings.fix: Render no bar when f[2]==0; give .tsp-bar margin-inline-start:auto off, i.e. anchor it to the inline start (justify-self:start in a logical grid), and use min-inline-size only when the value is above 0.

pages.task: Find a student and open their record or result
pages.summary: The list works, but the help text points the counselor to a legacy page it cannot reach, half the filters are hidden off-screen on phones, and every row links to a page that crashes.

findings.issue: The intro says new invitations are sent 'فعلاً از «دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)»'. That legacy page is not in the counselor's menu, and the new 'دعوت تازه' flow exists anyway, so the text is both stale and points to something the counselor can't reach.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; ISO 9241-112 consistency
findings.fix: See pattern PT-4.

findings.issue: Seven filter chips sit on one row that scrolls sideways with the scrollbar hidden. At 375 px only همه / مراجعان من / بدون کارشناس / واردشده show; بایگانی‌شده, درخواست واگذاری and مراجعان باز من can't be seen and nothing hints that the row scrolls. The search placeholder is cut off ('...موبایل یا ایه').
findings.fix: See pattern PT-7. Shorten the placeholder to «نام، شناسه، موبایل یا ایمیل».

findings.issue: The counselor sees the same filters as the owner, including 'درخواست واگذاری', which only matters to people who can approve handovers.
findings.evidence: counselor clients txt l.35-41 equal to owner l.41-47
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 freedom from distraction; ISO 9241-110 suitability for the task
findings.fix: Show the 'درخواست واگذاری' chip only when has_perm('clients:assign'); for counselors, put 'مراجعان من' first and make it the default view.

pages.task: Open the latest results I am allowed to read
pages.summary: Short and clear, but the 'سطح' column uses internal jargon and never says what the counselor will or won't see.

findings.issue: The 'سطح' column shows 'نتیجهٔ آموزشی' with no explanation of what that level includes or leaves out (no raw answers, no clinical text). The fact that opening or printing a result is logged is only stated in /help/panel.
findings.fix: Rename the column to «آنچه می‌بینید» and add one hint line under the heading: «سطح دسترسی شما: نتیجهٔ آموزشی (نیمرخ و پیشنهادها، بدون پاسخ‌های خام). هر بار باز کردن یا چاپ نتیجه در دفتر ممیزی پنل ثبت می‌شود.»

findings.issue: The table header and rows have the same white-surface problem in dark mode.
findings.fix: Pattern PT-1.

pages.task: Check whether the students I invited have opened or finished their assessment
pages.summary: The status filters are good, but the counselor can't tell their own invitations from colleagues', and the 8 chips overflow on phones.

findings.issue: The list has no 'invited by' column and no 'دعوت‌های من' filter. The counselor sees every panel invitation (2 here), not only their own, with nothing to tell them apart.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks; ISO 9241-112 discriminability
findings.fix: Add a 'فرستنده' column (data-label on cards) and a 'دعوت‌های من' chip that is on by default for roles without clients:read_all.

findings.issue: The eight status chips (همه through لغوشده) scroll sideways with no visible affordance. Five of them show ۰ and add noise.
findings.fix: Pattern PT-7; on phones, collapse zero-count chips behind a «وضعیت‌های دیگر» select.

pages.summary: Usable, but the count column is ambiguous for a role that only sees some rows, and the phone card is clipped.

findings.issue: 'تعداد ۰' gives no hint whether it counts all members or only the rows this counselor may see. The help text ('هر کس فقط ردیف‌های خودش را می‌بیند') hints the count is filtered, but the column doesn't say so.
findings.fix: Rename the column to «افراد قابل‌دیدن برای شما» for roles without clients:read_all, or show 'n از m' if the owner agrees that the total may be shown.

findings.issue: On phones the group card sits inside the table wrapper's frame, giving a double border and a clipped bottom edge.
findings.fix: In the max-width:767.98px block, remove the outer frame of the groups .ts-table-wrap (as panel.scss:146 does for direct children of .tsp-shell__main), or give the groups table the same direct-child structure.

pages.task: Enter the panel I belong to
pages.summary: The page works, but it calls panels «فضای کاری», gives 'build a new panel' the same weight as the counselor's real task, and shows an invitation count that disagrees with the dashboard.

findings.issue: The page title, intro and button use «فضاهای کاری» / «ورود به فضا», while the header, shell and help all say «پنل» («تغییر پنل», «ساخت پنل تازه», «پنل‌های من»).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency; project rule one term per concept (پنل)
findings.fix: Pattern PT-8: «پنل‌های من», «پنل‌هایی که عضو آن‌ها هستید…», button «ورود به پنل».

findings.issue: The card shows 'دعوت‌ها ۱ · تکمیل‌شده ۱', but the dashboard of the same panel shows ۲ invitations sent and the invites page shows 'همه ۲'.
findings.evidence: counselor_my_workspaces_1280.txt l.27 vs counselor_my_workspaces_5_1280.txt l.41-42 and invites txt l.33-34 (same for owner)
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 consistency; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection (trust)
findings.fix: Make r['counts'] use the same state set as the dashboard and invites page (include 'opened'), or label what is counted. Also limit it to what the role may see.

findings.issue: Two primary-style buttons: 'ساخت پنل تازه' sits above the panel card and looks the same as 'ورود به فضا'. For a member whose only job is to enter their panel, creating a panel takes visual priority. The card also shows no panel state (active / pilot / awaiting approval).
findings.standard: Project rule one primary action per view; ISO 9241-125 hierarchy; ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness
findings.fix: Make 'ساخت پنل تازه' an outline/quiet link below the list when rows exist; keep 'ورود به پنل' primary. Add a state pill to each card (reuse the dashboard pill logic: در انتظار تأیید / فعال / آزمایشی).

pages.task: Land after sign-in and get to today's work
pages.summary: A counselor with three unassigned students and an unopened result is told «فعلاً کاری ندارید», and the panel link sits second.

findings.issue: The home page only counts participant tasks. For staff it says «فعلاً کاری ندارید», while the panel dashboard lists 1 unopened result and 3 unassigned students. Staff work is hidden under a secondary 'رفتن به پنل‌ها' card.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks, self-descriptiveness; ISO 9241-210 context of use
findings.fix: When memberships exist, render a «کارهای پنل» card first, with the dashboard's attention items per panel (count + link) and a primary «ورود به پنل <name>» button. Change the empty heading to «کار شخصی‌ای ندارید» so it doesn't read as 'no work at all'.

findings.issue: The sub-tab row is cut off at 375 px ('چه کسی می‌بیند' clipped, 'حساب' off-screen) with no scroll affordance.
findings.fix: Pattern PT-7.

pages.task: Open one student's record: details, responsible counselor, assessments and results
pages.summary: The page fails with HTTP 500 and an English, LTR, unbranded error. The likely cause is an undefined template variable.

findings.issue: HTTP 500 for counselor and owner. The template uses `client.id` in the result links, but the controller passes `c`, so any client with a done assignment or imported attempt crashes the page. Client 110 has a completed assignment. The counselor's 'back to participant' link from the report (P9) also lands here.
findings.evidence: report.txt rows 131-132, 199-200 'status 500'; web_client.xml:137 and :143 `/clients/#{client.id}/r/...`; clients.py:421-427 passes c=c (no `client`)
findings.standard: ISO 9241-11 effectiveness; ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness; ISO/IEC 25010 operability
findings.fix: In web_client.xml:137 and :143 replace `client.id` with `c.id`. Add this route with a done assignment to the HTTP suite (`ts check` doesn't catch undefined names). Confirm with `ts db errors`.

findings.issue: The error page is English ('500: Internal Server Error', title 'Internal Server Error'), dir=ltr, has no lang attribute and no h1. It offers no Persian explanation, no way back into the panel and no support link.
findings.evidence: counselor_my_workspaces_5_clients_110_375.png; report.txt row 199 'h1=0; EN Error; dir=ltr; lang=-'
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 3.1.1, 2.4.2; ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness; Persian/RTL no English UI
findings.fix: Add a website-2 500 template like the existing 404 override: «مشکلی پیش آمد» h1, a short Persian explanation, 'بازگشت به پنل' (Referer or /my/workspaces), and 'تماس با پشتیبانی' with a reference code.

findings.issue: The back link is written '← شرکت‌کنندگان'. In RTL, 'back' should point to the inline start (→).
findings.standard: Persian/RTL logical direction; ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations
findings.fix: Use '→ شرکت‌کنندگان' or the shared .ts-back class (as web_talent.xml:193 does), which draws a direction-aware chevron.

pages.task: Read a student's talent profile to prepare a counselling conversation
pages.summary: The counselor-facing report keeps addressing the student as «شما», is 12 000 px long on a phone with no way to jump between sections, and its 'back' link leads to the 500 page.

findings.issue: The org_view switch only changes the header and lead. The interpretive sections, the 'next step' list and the closing notes still speak to the participant: 'ترکیب غالب در زمینه‌های شما', 'ضعیف‌ترین استعداد شما', 'برداشت شما از خودتان', 'اگر نتیجه برایتان پرسش ایجاد کرده یا نگران‌تان کرده است'. A counselor reads text that seems to describe them, and the voice flips mid-document.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability, consistency; ISO 9241-210 designed around the real user
findings.fix: Pass org_view into the section macros and use third-person variants («زمینه‌های او», «ضعیف‌ترین استعداد او»). Swap the 'worried' line for a counselor note: «اگر شرکت‌کننده نگران است، او را به متخصص ارجاع دهید.»

findings.issue: 'بازگشت به شرکت‌کننده' points to /clients/110, which returns 500 (P8-1). The counselor's only way out is a dead end.
findings.fix: Fixed by P8-1. Also add a second link to the clients list.

findings.issue: The page is 12 136 px tall at 375 px. A counselor between classes has no jump links to the summary, the table or the programmes, and the long book definitions sit inline.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the task; ISO 9241-112 conciseness; WCAG 2.2 2.4.1
findings.fix: Add an in-page contents bar (خلاصه · زمینه‌ها · تفسیر · برنامه‌ها · جدول کامل) under the meta block. Put 'دربارهٔ این سنجه' behind a button with aria-expanded (not <details>, see CLAUDE.md).

findings.issue: In a tie, the summary tile 'برجسته‌ترین زمینه' lists all four fields ('ریاضی، هنر، ورزش و زبان ۶۰٫۰'), and 'استعداد ضعیف' names the same four as 'پایین‌ترین زمینه'. The same fields are both strongest and weakest.
findings.fix: When every field ties, show «همهٔ زمینه‌ها برابرند (۶۰٫۰)» and drop the strongest/weakest field statements. The engine output doesn't change.

findings.issue: The access line is vague ('در دسترس گذاشته یا مؤسسه پیشتر دریافت کرده است'). It doesn't say which share level the counselor sees or that opening and printing are logged.
findings.fix: «شما این گزارش را در سطح مشاور می‌بینید (بدون پاسخ‌های خام). باز کردن و چاپ آن در دفتر ممیزی پنل ثبت می‌شود.» Put it near the top as well as the end.

findings.issue: The book text contains an Arabic ي ('تحريك'), missing ZWNJs ('تواناییهای پنجگانهٔ', 'دسته‌بندیهای', 'دانسته ها'), and the خلّاقیّت نظری and خلّاقیّت عملی definitions are the same paragraph.
findings.fix: Normalise ي→ی and add ZWNJ at display time (norm_text) without editing the stored verbatim text. Split the combined definition into two sentences per scale.

findings.issue: Dark mode: title, lead and meta fall to contrast 1.2-2.0.
findings.fix: Pattern PT-1. .ts-doc likely uses var(--white) as its paper colour; use the surface token.

pages.task: Understand the panel's state and start working with my first client
pages.summary: The panel's pilot state shows as «فعال», and an empty panel fills the screen with eight zeros plus a separate empty message.

findings.issue: PANEL_STATE_LABELS maps both 'pilot' and 'active' to «فعال» with a green pill. A clinical pilot panel can't be told apart from a fully active one. The gated notice ('در انتظار تأیید') appears only on the dashboard, only while gated, and is absent from the clients, invites and reports pages.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (state of the system); ISO/IEC 25010 appropriateness recognisability
findings.fix: Pattern PT-3: label 'pilot' «آزمایشی» with an info pill and a one-line notice on every shell page (shell_frame) while state=='pilot' or gated.

findings.issue: With zero data the page shows four zero KPI tiles, five zero funnel rows and then a separate empty message. The real empty state comes last, below a 900-px block of zeros.
findings.fix: When total==0, skip the tiles and funnel sections. Render one empty state right after the header: what this panel is for, what the clinician can do now ('دعوت تازه' if can_invite), and a link to /help/roles.

findings.issue: The page never says what a clinician sees here (full report with therapist texts, only for clients assigned to them, and only once professionally verified).
findings.evidence: clinician_my_workspaces_6_1280.txt (no role text); CLAUDE.md visibility rules
findings.fix: Pattern PT-2.

pages.summary: The empty state sends the clinician to the unreachable legacy page, and filters that make no sense for an empty list are still shown.

findings.issue: Both the intro and the empty state say to use «دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)». That page is not in the clinician menu; the menu has 'دعوت‌ها' and the dashboard has 'دعوت تازه'.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations; NN/g empty states
findings.fix: Pattern PT-4 (empty state: «هنوز مراجعی ندارید. با دعوت تازه اولین دعوت را بفرستید یا مراجع را دستی ثبت کنید.» with the matching buttons).

findings.issue: On an empty panel, 7 filter chips, the search box and 'نماهای ذخیره‌شده و ستون‌ها' are all shown. They do nothing yet.
findings.fix: Hide the search, chips and saved views when the unfiltered total is 0.

findings.issue: The empty-state paragraph falls to contrast 1.2 in dark mode.
findings.fix: Pattern PT-1 (.tsp-empty background/colour tokens).

pages.summary: A clean empty state, but it doesn't explain why nothing is visible (no results yet, not assigned, or not yet verified).

findings.issue: «هنوز نتیجه‌ای که بتوانید ببینید وجود ندارد» gives no next step and no reason. For a clinician, results also depend on assignment and professional verification. The 'گزارش گروهی' button is shown to the reviewer but not to the clinician, with no explanation.
findings.fix: Make the empty text depend on the role: «نتیجه‌ها وقتی مراجعی که مسئول او هستید سنجه را تمام کند، اینجا می‌آید. گزارش کامل بالینی فقط برای متخصص احرازشده باز است.» Add a link to 'دعوت تازه' if can_invite.

pages.task: See candidates waiting for my review
pages.summary: The reviewer is told to press a «دعوت تازه» button that isn't there, the help line promises sections that never render, and nothing says the reviewer sees only bands.

findings.issue: The empty state says «هنوز دعوتی نفرستاده‌اید. با «دعوت تازه» اولین دعوت را بسازید.» The reviewer can't invite (no button is rendered, can_invite is false), and reviewers don't send invitations at all.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations; NN/g empty states; Nielsen match between system and real world
findings.fix: Pattern PT-5: for roles without invites:create show «هنوز نتیجه‌ای برای بازبینی نیست. وقتی داوطلبی سنجه را تمام کند، خلاصهٔ او در «شرکت‌کنندگان» دیده می‌شود.»

findings.issue: Nothing on the page says the reviewer sees only the band per factor (no scores, answers or texts). That's the most important thing for this role to know, and it guards against misreading.
findings.evidence: reviewer_my_workspaces_7_1280.txt (no visibility statement); CLAUDE.md ts_org visibility
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness; ISO/IEC 25010 appropriateness recognisability, user error protection
findings.fix: Pattern PT-2, with the reviewer text «شما در این پنل فقط سطح (بازه) هر عامل را می‌بینید؛ نمره، پاسخ و متن تفسیری نمایش داده نمی‌شود.»

findings.issue: The help line 'اول کارهای منتظر شما، بعد خلاصهٔ دوره…' sits above a page that has neither, because the reviewer gets no tiles or funnel. The fallback 'برای نقش شما شاخصی در این بخش نیست' never shows, since it lives inside the section that is skipped.
findings.evidence: reviewer txt l.26-30; web_dashboard.xml:18, :54 (t-if tiles or funnel), :74
findings.fix: Show the help line only when attention/tiles exist. Otherwise give the reviewer a short role summary and a link to 'شرکت‌کنندگان'.

findings.issue: The state pill shows «فعال» for a pilot employment panel (same root cause as P10-1).
findings.fix: Pattern PT-3.

findings.issue: The fixed tab bar covers the bottom of the footer: the copyright and emergency line (۱۱۵) are hidden under it.
findings.evidence: reviewer_my_workspaces_7_375.png bottom; panel.scss:45 pads only .tsp-section, :59 fixed .tsp-tabbar
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.4.11 focus not obscured; ISO 9241-112 detectability
findings.fix: Pattern PT-6.

pages.summary: The reviewer gets the counselor/owner filter set and two pointers to an invitation route it can neither see nor use.

findings.issue: The intro and the empty state tell the reviewer to send invitations through «دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)». The reviewer has no invite permission and that page isn't in the menu.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations; NN/g empty states
findings.fix: Pattern PT-4/PT-5: «هنوز داوطلبی در این پنل نیست. وقتی مدیر استخدام دعوت بفرستد و داوطلب سنجه را تمام کند، اینجا دیده می‌شود.»

findings.issue: The reviewer sees 'مراجعان من', 'بدون کارشناس', 'درخواست واگذاری' and 'مراجعان باز من'. These are responsible-specialist and clinical terms ('مراجع') that mean nothing for an employment reviewer who sees every candidate. The page also uses «شرکت‌کننده» rather than the purpose-specific «داوطلب».
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks; ISO 9241-112 freedom from distraction; one term per concept
findings.fix: Choose the chip set from purpose and permission: for employment reviewers show همه / تکمیل‌شده / بایگانی‌شده only. Keep «شرکت‌کننده» as the one term (or have the owner approve «داوطلب» for employment).

findings.issue: The fixed tab bar overlaps the footer links ('راهنما · حریم خصوصی و رضایت · تماس با پشتیبانی' are partly covered).
findings.fix: Pattern PT-6.

pages.task: See recent band summaries and the group report
pages.summary: A short page, but neither it nor the 'گزارش گروهی' entry tells the reviewer that only bands are visible.

findings.issue: The intro 'تازه‌ترین نتیجه‌هایی که می‌توانید ببینید' doesn't say that a reviewer only gets bands. The empty state gives no next step.
findings.fix: Intro for band-only roles: «برای هر داوطلب فقط سطح هر عامل نمایش داده می‌شود؛ نمره و پاسخ دیده نمی‌شود.» Empty state as in P13-1.

findings.issue: The reviewer gets 'گزارش گروهی' and the clinician doesn't. The page gives no reason, so the role differences look arbitrary.
findings.evidence: reviewer reports txt l.28 vs clinician reports txt (absent); web_reports.xml:85 can_group
findings.fix: Keep the permission, but list 'گزارش گروهی' in the role summary (PT-2) so its presence or absence is explained.

patterns.issue: Dark mode: panel cards, KPI tiles, tables, card-rows, empty states and the report paper use var(--white), a non-theme value, so they stay white while the text turns light (contrast 1.2-2.0).
patterns.fix: In ts_panel/static/src/scss/panel.scss (:117 .tsp-stat, :144 .tsp-table, :145 .ts-table-wrap, :159 .tsp-table--cards tr, .tsp-empty), ts_assessment assessment.scss:68 .ts-table and the .ts-doc paper, replace var(--white) with var(--color-surface) or a new --color-card token with light and dark values. Re-run the shots: rows 180-192, 204, 266-279 should come back ok. Severity 3.

patterns.issue: Non-owner roles are never told what they can and cannot see. The role is plain grey text in the shell; /help/roles exists but nothing links to it, and its counselor line leaves out the unassigned queue.
pages: all 12 panel pages of counselor, clinician, reviewer
patterns.fix: In web_shell.xml:24/:44, make role_label a link to /help/roles#<role>. On the dashboard, under the header, add one sentence per (role, purpose) from a dict in base.py, e.g. counselor/education «شاگردانی را که مسئول آن‌ها هستید و صف بدون کارشناس را می‌بینید؛ گزارش در سطح مشاور.», clinician/clinical «فقط مراجعانی را که مسئول آن‌ها هستید می‌بینید؛ گزارش کامل بالینی پس از احراز صلاحیت.», reviewer/employment «فقط سطح هر عامل را می‌بینید؛ نمره و پاسخ نمایش داده نمی‌شود.» Presentation only; access logic is unchanged. Severity 3.

patterns.issue: Panel state is hidden: 'pilot' is labelled «فعال» like 'active', the gated notice exists only on the dashboard, and the panel list cards show no state.
patterns.fix: base.py:44 'pilot': 'آزمایشی' with an info pill. Move the gated/pilot notice from web_dashboard.xml:25-29 into shell_frame (above t-out 0) so it shows on every panel page, worded per role (members who cannot invite don't need the invitation sentence). Add the pill to ts_org.workspaces cards. Coverage note: the shots have no gated (unapproved) or unverified-clinician panel, so those states were not audited; add a gated panel and an unverified clinician to the shot fixtures. Severity 3.

patterns.issue: Stale copy everywhere: «دعوت جدید فعلاً از «دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)» انجام می‌شود» even though 'دعوت تازه' exists, and the legacy page is in no non-owner menu.
patterns.fix: web_clients.xml:17 → «افرادی که در این پنل دعوت شده‌اند یا نتیجهٔ آن‌ها به پنل رسیده است.» web_clients.xml:51 → role-aware empty state with a «دعوت تازه» button when can_invite and «شرکت‌کنندهٔ جدید» when can_write, and no mention of the legacy page. Severity 3.

patterns.issue: Empty-state and attention copy ignores permissions: it tells roles to press buttons they don't have (dashboard empty text for the reviewer) and lists queues they can't act on (unassigned queue for the counselor).
patterns.fix: Pass can_invite / can_assign into every empty and attention text. Never name an action the role can't perform; name who can («مالک یا مدیر استخدام پنل»). Severity 3.

patterns.issue: On phones the fixed bottom tab bar covers the end of the site footer (copyright and the ۱۱۵ emergency line, and sometimes the footer links), because only .tsp-section is padded.
patterns.fix: In the max-width:1023.98px block, add `body:has(.tsp-tabbar) .ts-footer { padding-block-end: calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }`, or pad #wrapwrap when the tab bar is present. Severity 2.

patterns.issue: Horizontal chip and tab rows (.tsp-chips, .tsp-subnav, /my tabs) scroll with the scrollbar hidden and no edge fade, so filters and tabs beyond 375 px can't be found.
patterns.fix: Allow wrapping (flex-wrap: wrap) for rows of 6 chips or fewer. For longer rows, keep the scroll but add an inline-end mask-image fade and scroll-padding, and on phones put the less-used chips behind a «بیشتر» select. Severity 2.

patterns.issue: Two terms for one concept: «فضای کاری / فضا» (ts_org list, portal entry) vs «پنل» (shell, header, help, /my).
patterns.fix: Use «پنل» throughout: web_org.xml:4-5,20,25,26,30,43,46 and the portal.entry name. Severity 2.

patterns.issue: For non-owners the menu group heading «پنل» contains only «راهنما», a heading over a single unrelated item.
pages: all counselor, clinician and reviewer shell pages
patterns.fix: Give 'help' no group (or the group «راهنما») when the role has no members/settings items; in web_shell.xml:30 the group label then disappears. Severity 1.
